annotations.title: LEI Lookup: Legal Entity Identifier by LEI or Company Name

description: Look up a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) record by 20-character LEI, or search legal entities by name and country. Returns legal name, registry number, legal form, addresses and LEI registration status. Company-level data only. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

country.description: ISO 3166 country code of the legal address, e.g. DK.

lei.description: Exact 20-character LEI. If set, name and country are ignored.

limit.description: Maximum records for a name search.

name.description: Legal name to search (exact match on registered legal name, e.g. "Novo Nordisk A/S").

name: lei_lookup
